name: Material Library
summary: Passive target-owned material reference collection with optional context, complete named records, contextual media, and canonical Tag composition.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named native section when a visible title is supplied; otherwise a semantically neutral container. Omitted when the required materials composition is absent or empty.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional introductory wrapper, emitted only when title or subtitle is present.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading and section label when supplied.

anatomy.name: collection
anatomy.description: Native unordered list of complete target-owned material records.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native list item containing exactly one direct Material Card.

anatomy.name: card
anatomy.description: Passive native article named by its required visible material name.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Optional target media slot with context-appropriate image alternatives.

anatomy.name: name
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible contextual heading used to name the Material Card article.

anatomy.name: type
anatomy.description: Optional target-authored material classification; no vocabulary is implied.

anatomy.name: properties
anatomy.description: Optional native list of passive material-property labels.

anatomy.name: propertyItem
anatomy.description: Native list item containing one canonical passive Tag.

anatomy.name: propertyTag
anatomy.description: Local composition hook applied to canonical .tag with required visible .tag__label and no remove action in the passive R1 baseline.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic collection layout governed by the actual host width.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive document presentation with no root interaction state.

behavior.name: semanticRoot
attributes: aria-labelledby only when the visible title is present
behavior.description: A visible title produces a named native section; without a title the same composition uses a generic div and emits no dangling labelling relationship.

behavior.name: nonEmptyMaterials
behavior.description: The required materials slot must provide at least one complete item with a stable key and non-empty visible name; otherwise the complete R1 root is omitted.

behavior.name: passiveRecords
behavior.description: Material Cards are passive named articles with no root role, tabindex, hover state, selection, destination or event. Any future target action composes its own truthful canonical control.

behavior.name: mediaAlternatives
behavior.description: The target supplies a useful alternative when media conveys material information and alt="" when it is decorative or redundant; textual identity remains required.

behavior.name: canonicalPropertyTags
behavior.description: Optional properties use a native list of canonical passive Tag instances; R1 does not duplicate Tag styling or expose its remove action.

behavior.name: targetOwnedRecords
behavior.description: Targets own records, source order, taxonomy, localization, truth, media, mapping and lifecycle; the neutral contract defines only durable composition.

behavior.name: zeroRuntime
behavior.description: The neutral component owns no listener, observer, timer, request, selection store, filter, sort, navigation, pagination or target service.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional visible contextual heading; its presence selects named-section semantics.

properties.name: materials
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned native Material Card collection; no CMS or record shape is implied.

accessibility: Use a contextual visible heading when R1 should be a document section; title-absent compositions remain generic and emit no broken label reference.
Render a native unordered list with one direct list item and one named native article per complete material record.
Keep the material name and every essential technical/property fact available as text; never rely on color, texture or imagery alone.
Give informative media a context-specific alt value and decorative or text-redundant media alt=""; do not claim that editorial imagery is a raw sample.
Use canonical passive Tags for compact property labels and term/value semantics when technical facts require named values.
Do not add grid/listbox roles, roving focus, whole-card activation or hover affordance to the passive neutral collection.

web.notes: Native conditional section/div, list/item/article composition, canonical Tag leaves, intrinsic CSS and zero R1 JavaScript.

shopify.notes: Requires approved record source, editor schema, ordering/limits, material-product relationship and first template consumer before target-native implementation.
